about: The fake provider's error answers (crates/fake-harness, T1a-03). Each says where its shape came from:
"recorded" names the recording; "unrecorded" waits for the gate's hand run on a real key;
"from the docs, unrecorded" follows Anthropic's documented errors (platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors; the spend cap's from /api/rate-limits)
until a recording replaces it. A test that reads an unrecorded fixture says so. Only the headers listed
were recorded or documented; the provider adds its own content-length, and content_type is the body's type.

fixtures.recorded: api.anthropic.com, POST /v1/messages with a dummy x-api-key, 2026-11-15 20:52 UTC (T1a-02's spike record, 1a-startup). Every header in the order received, identifiers redacted as the record has them; the body's error type recorded.
